name: admission_refused
description: Sent to the parent when a place is refused. Must include the right of appeal.
subject: Your application for {child_name} ({application_ref})
body: We are sorry to tell you that we are unable to offer {child_first_name} a place in Year {year_group} for {academic_year}.

You have the right to appeal against this decision to an independent appeal panel. If you wish to appeal, please contact us and quote your reference {application_ref}; we will send you the appeal form and tell you the deadline for lodging it.
You can also ask for {child_first_name} to be placed on the waiting list.

placeholders.child_first_name: The child's preferred or first name
placeholders.child_name: The child's preferred first name and surname
placeholders.academic_year: The academic year applied for, e.g. 2026/27
